question.text: How much funding will Wild Animal Initiative receive in 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as the financial amount (in US Dollars) reported under "Contributions and grants" (Part 1, Section 8 - Revenue) in [the Form 990 tax filing](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/822281466) for Wild Animal Initiative Inc. for the fiscal year ending December 2026.
question.fine_print: If Wild Animal Initiative ceases to exist or no Form 990 tax filing is made for the fiscal year ending December 2026, this question will be **annulled**.

# Wild Animal Initiative (WAI): Form 990 "Contributions and grants" for FY2026, research brief

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-12: ProPublica's latest filing is for FY2024, filed 2025-08-19. It shows contributions and grants of $2,325,327, total revenue of $2,487,849, expenses of $3,345,940 and net assets of $6,716,700. No FY2025 or FY2026 990 is posted yet. Past filing dates ran from July to November of the following year, so the FY2026 990 would likely appear between mid and late 2027. [ProPublica](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/822281466)
- A third-party balance-sheet mirror says about 81% of FY2024 assets were receivables, so I could not verify it. If true, it fits large multi-year grants being booked as revenue in the year they are awarded (2021: $5.1M, 2023: $6.8M), which matches the lumpy history. [Impala](https://impala.digital/public/profiles/82-2281466/financials/balance-sheet)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. I found no public figure for WAI's 2025 or 2026 revenue.
- The key unknowns are in what year The Navigation Fund (TNF) bridge grant (about $1M) is booked, and whether TNF or another large funder makes a 2027 award in late 2026 that gets booked in 2026.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-24: ACE's update says WAI got $339,295 from ACE's Recommended Charity Fund in its February 2026 distribution. [ACE](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/blog/recommended-charity-fund-update-august-2026/)
- 2026-08-14: A Rethink Priorities post covering five wild animal welfare organizations lists WAI's 2026 budget as $4,280,000. It puts WAI's 2027 room for more funding at $1.42M to $6.09M, the largest of the five, and says WAI receives most of the funding in the space. [EA Forum mirror](https://ea.greaterwrong.com/posts/HDpwbQjes34gkkgKn/five-wild-animal-welfare-organizations-estimate-usd3-8m-in)
- 2026-06 (approximate): WAI announced 13 research grants totaling $727,658. [WAI](https://www.wildanimalinitiative.org/blog/2026-grants)
- 2026-05: WAI published its 2025 annual report. The EA update thread entry gives no financial figures. [EA Forum mirror](https://ea.greaterwrong.com/posts/ipvoeRPfd4bAMSwBm/ea-organisation-updates-thread-may-2026/comment/QD3swmCgK6qJmhSdM)
- 2025-11-18: WAI's funding priorities post gives a 2025 budget of $3.772M and a 2026 target of $4.1M, with only $267K of 2026 still unfunded at that point. It says Open Philanthropy had covered more than half the budget but no longer funds wild animal welfare, and that WAI got its first grants from non-EA foundations in 2025. [EA Forum mirror](https://ea.greaterwrong.com/posts/wJnEm7hbKBvDaAa6p/funding-priorities-for-wild-animal-initiative-in-2026-1)
- 2025-11: Open Philanthropy renamed itself Coefficient Giving. I found no Coefficient Giving grant to WAI in 2026. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coefficient_Giving)
- 2024-10-02: WAI said its Open Philanthropy grant was $2M per year through 2026-06-30. TNF made a non-binding commitment of about $1M to cover July to December 2026, and would decide "in late 2026" whether to fund 2027. WAI rated renewal as moderately likely and aimed to be fully funded without Open Philanthropy or TNF by the end of 2027. [EA Forum mirror](https://ea.greaterwrong.com/posts/BL7ennvpCZKXJbbYH/)
- 2023-07: Open Philanthropy gave WAI $6M, booked in FY2023 ($6.82M in contributions). [WAI](https://www.wildanimalinitiative.org/blog/2023-op-grant)

## 4. Base rates
- Contributions by year: 2019 $0.72M, 2020 $0.61M, 2021 $5.09M, 2022 $1.72M, 2023 $6.82M, 2024 $2.33M. FY2025 has not been published.
- The pattern alternates: years with a large multi-year grant (2021, 2023) come in at $5M to $7M, and years without one at $1.7M to $2.3M. Year-to-year changes have been 3x to 4x in either direction.
- In "off" years, contributions ran 55% to 94% of expenses: 2022 was $1.72M against $1.84M, and 2024 was $2.33M against $3.35M.
- 2026 is the first year without Open Philanthropy. Since its money was likely booked in 2023, it would not show up in 2026 revenue anyway.
- Seasonality: no intra-year contribution data exists for comparison. EA giving tends to cluster in the November-December giving season, and that is when TNF's renewal decision is due.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on WAI's revenue. None of the Kalshi markets supplied with this request relate to this question.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Late 2026: TNF decides whether to fund WAI in 2027. A multi-year or 2027 award made in 2026 could be booked as FY2026 revenue.
- November to December 2026: ACE announces its 2026 Recommended Charities. WAI's 2025 recommendation was renewed, but the 2026 list was not yet public as of this search. [EA Forum](https://forum-bots.effectivealtruism.org/posts/waL3iwczrjNt8PreZ/announcing-ace-s-2025-charity-recommendations)
- Also in the giving season: EA Forum Marginal Funding Week and the Donation Election, ACE Recommended Charity Fund distributions, and possible EA Animal Welfare Fund grants. I found no WAI 2026 Marginal Funding Week post yet.
- Mid to late 2027: the FY2025 990 (a useful check on how the TNF grant was booked) and then the FY2026 990 appear on ProPublica.

I could not find: WAI's 2025 or 2026 revenue figures, the exact amount and booking year of the TNF grant, any 2026 TNF renewal decision, or any non-EA foundation grant amounts.

Sources: [ProPublica](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/822281466), [Impala](https://impala.digital/public/profiles/82-2281466/financials/balance-sheet), [ACE Aug 2026](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/blog/recommended-charity-fund-update-august-2026/), [RP five orgs post](https://ea.greaterwrong.com/posts/HDpwbQjes34gkkgKn/five-wild-animal-welfare-organizations-estimate-usd3-8m-in), [WAI 2026 grants](https://www.wildanimalinitiative.org/blog/2026-grants), [WAI 2026 priorities](https://ea.greaterwrong.com/posts/wJnEm7hbKBvDaAa6p/funding-priorities-for-wild-animal-initiative-in-2026-1), [Funding landscape 2024](https://ea.greaterwrong.com/posts/BL7ennvpCZKXJbbYH/), [WAI $6M grant](https://www.wildanimalinitiative.org/blog/2023-op-grant), [Coefficient Giving](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coefficient_Giving), [May 2026 update](https://ea.greaterwrong.com/posts/ipvoeRPfd4bAMSwBm/ea-organisation-updates-thread-may-2026/comment/QD3swmCgK6qJmhSdM), [ACE 2025 recs](https://forum-bots.effectivealtruism.org/posts/waL3iwczrjNt8PreZ/announcing-ace-s-2025-charity-recommendations)

# Wild Animal Initiative: 2026 contributions and grants (Form 990, Part I line 8)

The 2026 figure is not known yet and won't be filed until roughly August to November 2027. The main things to weigh are below: Open Philanthropy has left, the Navigation Fund is bridging only through 2026, the past filings swing year to year, and I could not read the 2025 Form 990.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-12: ProPublica's latest filing is for FY2024, filed 2025-08-19. It shows contributions of $2,325,327, total revenue of $2,487,849, expenses of $3,345,940 and net assets of $6,716,700. There is nothing for FY2025 or FY2026 yet. [ProPublica](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/822281466)
- Past filing dates were between July and November of the following year, so the FY2026 return would likely appear between about August and November 2027. [ProPublica](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/822281466)
- WAI's own transparency page links a 2025 Form 990 and a 2025 audit. The 990 PDF was compressed and the audit PDF was encrypted, so I could not read either, and I could not get the 2025 line 8 figure. It is worth opening them by hand. [WAI transparency](https://www.wildanimalinitiative.org/transparency), [2025 990](https://www.wildanimalinitiative.org/s/WAI-990-2025-Public-Inspection.pdf)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. The fiscal year is still running and no 2026 financial figures have been published.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-10: Animal Charity Evaluators kept WAI on its recommended list for 2026, carrying over its 2025 status. ACE says WAI has awarded 96 research grants totaling nearly $6 million to date. [ACE](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/blog/announcing-our-2026-charity-recommendations/)
- 2026-08-24: ACE's Recommended Charity Fund update lists a $339,295 grant to WAI, which appears to come from the February 2026 payout. [ACE](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/blog/recommended-charity-fund-update-august-2026/)
- 2026-06-23: WAI announced 13 new research grants totaling $727,658. [WAI](https://www.wildanimalinitiative.org/blog/2026-grants)
- May 2026: WAI published its 2025 annual report. [EA Forum thread](https://ea.greaterwrong.com/posts/ipvoeRPfd4bAMSwBm/ea-organisation-updates-thread-may-2026)
- 2025-11-18: WAI put its 2025 budget at $3,772,000 and its 2026 target at $4,100,000. It said it was $267,000 short of that target and could use another $3.145M on top. It also said it had received its first grants from foundations outside effective altruism, and that Open Philanthropy, once more than half its budget, no longer funds the area. [EA Forum](https://ea.greaterwrong.com/posts/wJnEm7hbKBvDaAa6p/funding-priorities-for-wild-animal-initiative-in-2026-1)
- 2025: ACE estimated WAI's 2024 revenue at $3.8M, against $2.33M on the 990, which suggests a different accounting basis. ACE said WAI could use about $6.9M a year in 2026 and 2027 and holds net assets above 230% of its 2024 spending. [ACE review](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/charity-review/wild-animal-initiative/)
- 2024-11-19: WAI said it had secured short-term funding from the Navigation Fund. [EA Forum](https://ea.greaterwrong.com/posts/pEtxF6fJr5M6H5fbC/wild-animal-initiative-2024-review-and-2025-plans)
- 2024-10-02: Open Philanthropy's grant of $2M a year runs through 2026-06-30. The Navigation Fund made a non-binding plan to give about $1M covering July to December 2026, and will decide in late 2026 whether to renew for 2027. [EA Forum](https://ea.greaterwrong.com/posts/BL7ennvpCZKXJbbYH/)

## 4. Base rates
- Contributions by year on the 990: 2019 $0.72M; 2020 $0.61M; 2021 $5.09M; 2022 $1.72M; 2023 $6.82M; 2024 $2.33M. [ProPublica](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/822281466)
- The figure has swung sharply up and down by year: 2021 and 2023 were high, 2022 and 2024 were low. 2022 to 2024 averaged about $3.6M, roughly matching spending of $3.3M to $4.4M a year.
- My inference, not confirmed: the 2021 and 2023 spikes match Open Philanthropy's multi-year awards (2021: $3.5M over two years; 2023: about $2M a year through mid-2026). Nonprofit accounting usually counts an unconditional multi-year grant as revenue in the year it is awarded, which would explain the pattern. If so:
  - 2026 would have no Open Philanthropy money in it.
  - The roughly $1M Navigation Fund grant could fall in 2025 or in 2026, depending on when it was awarded.
  - Any 2027 renewal decided in late 2026 could also be counted in 2026.
- Without a large multi-year grant, the low years (2022 and 2024) came in at $1.7M to $2.3M.
- Calendar pattern: contributions bunch up at year end (Giving Tuesday, December appeals, ACE's "Giving Season" campaign). This affects how 2026 is going so far, but there is no published year-to-date figure to compare with earlier years.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on WAI's revenue. None of the Kalshi markets supplied with the question are related to it.

## 6. Upcoming events before forecasts close (2026-12-31)
- Late 2026: the Navigation Fund decides whether to renew for 2027. A renewal awarded in 2026 could be counted in 2026. [EA Forum](https://ea.greaterwrong.com/posts/BL7ennvpCZKXJbbYH/)
- Late November to December 2026: WAI's year-end appeal, a likely EA Forum Marginal Funding Week post, Giving Tuesday (2026-12-01), and any matching campaigns tied to ACE's recommendation. I did not confirm any 2026 match.
- Possible ACE Recommended Charity Fund payouts, in the same pattern as the February and August 2026 rounds.
- Roughly Aug to Nov 2027: the FY2026 Form 990 is filed and appears on ProPublica. Before then, the 2025 Form 990 on WAI's site, if read by hand, would show whether the Navigation Fund grant was counted in 2025.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About 7 weeks remain in FY2026 (it ends 2026-12-31). The resolving Form 990 should be published around mid to late 2027.

(b) The latest resolution-source value is FY2024 contributions and grants of $2.33M, from the 990 filed 2025-08-19. FY2025 has not been published.

(c) If nothing changed, FY2026 would repeat a typical "off" year with no large multi-year grant booked, about $2.0M to $2.5M.

(d) If the trend continued, the alternating pattern would make 2026 an off year. Off-year amounts are growing (2022 $1.7M, 2024 $2.3M), which points to roughly $2.5M to $3M. The 2026 budget is $4.28M. The $6M Open Philanthropy grant covering 2026 was booked in 2023, so it will not appear in 2026 revenue.

(e) Year-to-year changes have been 3x to 4x in either direction, driven by the timing of large grants. The key swing factors for 2026 are:
- whether The Navigation Fund (TNF) bridge grant of about $1M is booked in 2025 or 2026;
- whether TNF or another large funder awards a 2027 or multi-year grant in late 2026, which would add $1M to $4M;
- whether 2026 pledges secured before November 2025 were already booked in 2025.

(f) No markets cover this. Rethink Priorities lists WAI's 2027 room for more funding at $1.4M to $6.1M, which implies 2027 was largely unfunded as of August 2026. In November 2025, WAI said only $267K of its 2026 budget was unfunded. The question creator's range is $1M to $7M.

(g) Low scenario: the TNF bridge grant and most 2026 pledges were booked in FY2025, TNF declines to fund 2027, and giving-season donations are weak. Contributions would come in near $1.0M to $1.3M. High scenario: TNF or a new non-EA foundation awards a large multi-year grant in December 2026, booked fully in FY2026. That would push contributions to $5M to $8M.

(a) **Time left:** Forecasts close on 2026-12-31. The FY2026 Form 990 will probably not appear on ProPublica until mid to late 2027, and resolution is around 2027-11-15. About seven weeks of the 2026 fiscal year remain, and that period includes the giving season.

(b) **Latest known value:** FY2024 contributions and grants were $2,325,327, from a 990 filed on 2025-08-19. FY2025 has not been published.

(c) **If nothing changed:** Repeating the last off-year figure gives about $2.3M.

(d) **If the current trend continued:**
- Budgets are rising: $3.77M in 2025 and $4.1M to $4.28M in 2026.
- Open Philanthropy's money was mostly booked in 2023, and at least some 2026 funding was probably booked in 2025 as pledges.
- Revenue counted in 2026 would then include:
  - individual and ACE-fund giving (ACE alone gave $339K in February);
  - possibly the roughly $1M Navigation Fund bridge grant, if it was booked in 2026;
  - any 2027 awards made in late 2026, such as a Navigation Fund renewal or non-EA foundation grants.
- Together these point to roughly $2.5M to $3.5M.

(e) **Historical variation:** The series is very lumpy, with year-over-year swings of 3x to 4x. Years with a large grant came in at $5M to $7M and years without one at $1.7M to $2.3M. The growing budget and the loss of a single dominant funder make the off-year floor higher.

(f) **Experts and markets:** There are no markets on this. Rethink Priorities estimates WAI's 2027 room for more funding at $1.42M to $6.09M, which means 2027 is largely unfunded as of August 2026. That leaves room for late-2026 awards booked this year. The question creator's range is $1M to $7M.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- Low: The Navigation Fund bridge and the multi-year foundation grants were all booked in 2025, the Navigation Fund declines to renew or defers to 2027, and individual giving is weak. Contributions come in near $1M to $1.3M.
- High: The Navigation Fund or a new foundation makes a multi-year award (2027 to 2028) in December 2026 that is booked in full. Contributions reach $6M to $8M.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- Low: TNF declines or delays to 2027, the 2026 pledges were all booked in 2025, and giving-season donations are weak. Contributions come in around $1M or below.
